capability: qualify supplied B2B leads with a deterministic score
canonical_claim: Calculate a lead score from supplied annual budget and requested seats, classify the lead at the approved threshold, and identify missing inputs without invention.

acceptance_criteria.description: The score equals annual_budget plus requested_seats multiplied by 1000.
A score greater than or equal to 75000 is QUALIFIED; a lower score is NOT_QUALIFIED.
Missing required inputs return INSUFFICIENT_INFORMATION and the missing field names.

implementation.instructions: Generate a deterministic component that computes score = annual_budget + requested_seats * 1000. Return an object with status and score when both fields exist. Status is QUALIFIED when score >= 75000 and NOT_QUALIFIED otherwise. If either required field is absent, return status INSUFFICIENT_INFORMATION and a missing array in input-contract order.

supported_scope: deterministic lead qualification from caller-supplied annual budget and seat count
unsupported_scope: CRM access, enrichment, probabilistic scoring and private customer data
limitations: the generated Replica implements only the formula and threshold approved in this Second-pass Result
